title: Warehouse reorder point
naturalLanguageRequirements: When the on-hand quantity of a stocked item falls below 20, the warehouse orders 100 units of that item from its supplier. Both numbers are stated. No second reorder rule is left open.
informalMarkdown:
# Functions

## Reorder stock

When the on-hand quantity of a stocked item falls below 20, the warehouse orders 100 units of that item from its supplier.

# Data Resources

## Stock item

The item records the sku, the on-hand quantity, and the supplier.

# Constraints

## Reorder rule

The reorder point is 20 units and the order quantity is 100 units. This rule is fully stated.
qualityNotes: DEV clear control. The reorder point and quantity are stated. A clarification that asks the analyst to pick a different point or quantity is a false clarification. Not part of the confirmatory freeze set.
